project-title.title: Learning based re-configuration, re-planning for dynamic changing environment in heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
Learning based re-configuration, re-planning for dynamic changing environment in heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems

project-description.description: This research proposal focuses on developing a theoretical framework in the area of control theory and multi-agent systems with practical applications (that will be tested) in safe transport systems, monitoring, and surveillance scenarios using autonomous robotic vehicles. The candidate will develop a framework unifying control Lyapunov functions and barrier functions (CLF-CBF) with optimization-based solutions and techniques in optimal control and reinforcement learning (RL) with formal guarantees. The key challenge (theoretical and practical) is the presence of uncertainty and disruptions; therefore, it is needed to update (as measurements arrive) the state awareness through active communication among the agents along with guaranteeing the safety of the system (collision among agents, or with static or dynamic obstacles) for achieving a given task. The candidate will also design a re-planning and re-configuration module using RL-based approach combined with CLF-CBF framework enabling the agents to learn about the changing environment, thus accomplishing the task suitably.
